Here are three recent news articles about AI:

1. **[AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?](https://www.fox10tv.com/2026/11/10/ai-your-job-threat-or-opportunity)**  
   Source: fox10tv.com  
   Summary: The article discusses how artificial intelligence is increasingly becoming part of everyday life, raising questions about its impact on jobs. While some economists warn that AI may threaten entry-level and repetitive jobs, others suggest it could create opportunities in sectors like construction and manufacturing.

2. **[Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego](https://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/local/googles-ai-ultimatum-forces-san-diego-schools-make-tough-choice/4099437)**  
   Source: nbcsandiego.com  
   Summary: San Diego County school districts face a deadline to decide whether to adopt Google's AI features or lose access to its search engine. The article highlights the debate among educators and students about the benefits and concerns of integrating AI into education.

3. **[Congress’s Permitting Bill Is a ‘Massive Giveaway’ to the AI Data Center Industry, Critics Warn](https://time.com/article/2026/11/10/permitting-bill-data-centers)**  
   Source: time.com  
   Summary: Critics argue that a new permitting bill in Congress could disproportionately benefit the AI data center industry. While supporters claim it represents a bipartisan victory, opponents are calling for more public input on how AI affects people's lives.

items.title: AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?
items.summary:
MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] But AI could also create opportunities. A Bloomberg article points to potential job growth in construction and manufacturing as companies build data centers and produce the chips that power the technology. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive. [...] The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego
items.summary:
As districts consider their options, students are already seeing artificial intelligence become a more common part of everyday learning.

“I feel like I see a lot of people using AI now,” said Delilah Ortiz, a student at El Camino High School.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. However, districts that want to continue using Google Search will have to opt in to the AI features.

### Tóm tắt bài viết: [AI and your job: Threat or opportunity?](https://www.fox10tv.com/2026/11/10/ai-your-job-threat-or-opportunity)

Bài viết thảo luận về sự gia tăng của trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) trong cuộc sống hàng ngày và tác động của nó đến công việc. Một số nhà kinh tế cho rằng AI có thể đe dọa các công việc cấp thấp và lặp đi lặp lại, như nhân viên tổng đài, nhập dữ liệu và viết nội dung cơ bản, vì những công việc này dễ dàng tự động hóa.

Mặc dù sự tăng trưởng việc làm trong một số lĩnh vực văn phòng như kế toán, luật và tài chính đã chậm lại, AI cũng có thể tạo ra cơ hội mới, đặc biệt trong ngành xây dựng và sản xuất khi các công ty xây dựng trung tâm dữ liệu và sản xuất chip. Những nhân viên văn phòng có kỹ năng cao cũng có thể hưởng lợi từ việc AI giúp họ làm việc hiệu quả hơn.

Tác động lâu dài của AI đối với việc làm vẫn chưa rõ ràng, nhưng người lao động có thể chuẩn bị bằng cách khám phá các công cụ như chatbot AI và trợ lý viết. Các chương trình đào tạo tại địa phương, như chương trình đào tạo lực lượng lao động AI của Đại học South Alabama, cũng có sẵn cho những ai muốn tìm hiểu thêm về AI.

Người lao động nên xem xét các kỹ năng có thể có giá trị trong tương lai và cách họ có thể trở thành nguồn lực đáng tin cậy khi công nghệ thay đổi.

MOBILE, Ala. ( [WALA](https://www.fox10tv.com/)) \- Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate.

Job growth in some office fields, including accounting, law and finance, has been slow, while tech and media jobs have declined since 2022. Microsoft also offered buyouts to tens of thousands of employees. Those trends do not necessarily mean AI caused the changes.

But AI could also create opportunities. A Bloomberg article points to potential job growth in construction and manufacturing as companies build data centers and produce the chips that power the technology. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive.

The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

Local training options are available for people who want to learn more. The University of South Alabama offers a hands-on AI workforce training program. The Alabama Community College System also runs workshops, including the AI Community Caravan, that teach foundational AI skills and scam awareness.

Workers can also consider what skills may be valuable in the years ahead, what problems employers may need help solving and how they can become a trusted resource as technology changes.
